info.title: Ledens Project Finance API
info.description: Uses existing ledens_session cookie. All writes require Origin equal to CORS_ORIGIN. Financial write grants are explicit; client role is always forbidden. Every bulk amount uses the source record gross basis, including sign. Only approved EUR records affect metrics. No automatic project assignment from ambiguous OCR.
